[Act: income-tax-1961
 Chapter: Offences and Prosecutions
 Section: 275A::Contravention of order made during search action.
]


Whoever contravenes any order referred to in the second proviso to sub-section (1) or sub-section (3) of section 132 shall be punishable with
24[simple imprisonment for a term up to two years and with fine].
